SELECT A.OFFICE_CODE AS OFFICE_CODE, A.BOARD_DIV AS BOARD_DIV, A.BOARD_NO AS BOARD_NO, A.BOARD_TITLE AS BOARD_TITLE, B.FILE_SEQ AS ATT_NO, A.BOARD_DATE AS BOARD_DATE, A.USER_ID AS USER_ID FROM dbo.TEN_BOARD A LEFT JOIN ( SELECT OFFICE_CODE, BOARD_DIV, BOARD_NO, MAX(FILE_SEQ) AS FILE_SEQ FROM dbo.TEN_FILE GROUP BY OFFICE_CODE, BOARD_DIV, BOARD_NO ) B ON A.OFFICE_CODE = B.OFFICE_CODE AND A.BOARD_DIV = B.BOARD_DIV AND A.BOARD_NO = B.BOARD_NO WHERE A.OFFICE_CODE = #{LOGINUSER_OFFICE_CODE} AND A.BOARD_DIV = #{BOARD_DIV}
AND ( A.BOARD_TITLE LIKE '%' + #{TEXT} + '%' OR A.BOARD_CONTENT LIKE '%' + #{TEXT} + '%' )
AND A.BOARD_TITLE LIKE '%' + #{TEXT} + '%'
AND A.BOARD_CONTENT LIKE '%' + #{TEXT} + '%'
ORDER BY A.BOARD_NO DESC, A.BOARD_DATE DESC, A.BOARD_TITLE

SELECT A.OFFICE_CODE AS OFFICE_CODE, A.BOARD_DIV AS BOARD_DIV, A.BOARD_NO AS BOARD_NO, A.BOARD_TITLE AS BOARD_TITLE, A.BOARD_CONTENT AS BOARD_CONTENT, A.BOARD_DATE AS BOARD_DATE, A.USER_ID AS USER_ID FROM dbo.TEN_BOARD A WHERE A.OFFICE_CODE = #{LOGINUSER_OFFICE_CODE} AND A.BOARD_DIV = #{BOARD_DIV} AND A.BOARD_NO = #{BOARD_NO} ORDER BY A.BOARD_DATE, A.BOARD_TITLE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO dbo.TEN_BOARD( OFFICE_CODE, BOARD_DIV, BOARD_NO, BOARD_TITLE, BOARD_CONTENT, BOARD_DATE, USER_ID ) SELECT #{LOGINUSER_OFFICE_CODE}, #{BOARD_DIV}, ISNULL(MAX(BOARD_NO), 0) + 1, #{BOARD_TITLE}, #{BOARD_CONTENT}, #{BOARD_DATE}, #{LOGINUSER_ID} FROM dbo.TEN_BOARD WHERE OFFICE_CODE = #{LOGINUSER_OFFICE_CODE} AND BOARD_DIV = #{BOARD_DIV}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM dbo.TEN_BOARD WHERE OFFICE_CODE = #{LOGINUSER_OFFICE_CODE} AND BOARD_DIV = #{BOARD_DIV} AND BOARD_NO = #{BOARD_NO}
mapper.select: SELECT A.OFFICE_CODE AS OFFICE_CODE, A.BOARD_DIV AS BOARD_DIV, A.BOARD_NO AS BOARD_NO, A.FILE_SEQ AS ATT_NO, A.FILE_NM, A.SYS_FILE_NM FROM dbo.TEN_FILE A JOIN dbo.TEN_BOARD B ON A.OFFICE_CODE = B.OFFICE_CODE AND A.BOARD_DIV = B.BOARD_DIV AND A.BOARD_NO = B.BOARD_NO WHERE A.OFFICE_CODE = #{LOGINUSER_OFFICE_CODE} AND A.BOARD_DIV = #{BOARD_DIV} AND A.BOARD_NO = #{BOARD_NO} ORDER BY A.FILE_SEQ, A.FILE_NM
SELECT A.DEPT_CD, A.DEPT_NAME FROM dbo.THR_DEPT A WHERE A.OFFICE_CODE = #{LOGINUSER_OFFICE_CODE} AND ISNULL(A.USE_YN,'Y') = 'Y' ORDER BY A.SORT_ORDER
SELECT A.JOB_DUTY_CD, A.JOB_DUTY_NAME FROM dbo.THR_JOB_DUTY A WHERE A.OFFICE_CODE = #{LOGINUSER_OFFICE_CODE} AND ISNULL(A.USE_YN,'Y') = 'Y' ORDER BY A.SORT_ORDER

SELECT A.OFFICE_CODE, A.EMP_NO, A.EMP_GBN, A.JOIN_DATE, A.DEPT_CD, B.DEPT_NAME, A.JOB_DUTY_CD, C.JOB_DUTY_NAME, A.NAME, A.HP_NO, ISNULL(A.USE_YN,'Y'), A.RESIGN_DATE, A.REMARKS, A.RESIGN_REASON, CASE WHEN NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(A.RESIGN_DATE)), '') IS NOT NULL AND A.RESIGN_DATE < CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), GETDATE(), 112) THEN '퇴사' WHEN (NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(A.RESIGN_DATE)), '') IS NULL OR A.RESIGN_DATE >= CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), GETDATE(), 112)) AND A.JOIN_DATE <= CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), GETDATE(), 112) THEN '재직' ELSE '' END AS JOIN_YN FROM dbo.TAD_TMP_EMP AS A LEFT JOIN dbo.THR_DEPT AS B ON A.OFFICE_CODE = B.OFFICE_CODE AND A.DEPT_CD = B.DEPT_CD LEFT JOIN dbo.THR_JOB_DUTY AS C ON A.OFFICE_CODE = C.OFFICE_CODE AND A.JOB_DUTY_CD = C.JOB_DUTY_CD WHERE A.OFFICE_CODE = #{LOGINUSER_OFFICE_CODE} AND A.EMP_GBN = #{EMP_GBN} AND (A.USE_YN = '' OR ISNULL(A.USE_YN,'Y') = 'Y')
AND (C.JOB_DUTY_NAME LIKE '%' + #{TEXT} + '%' OR A.NAME LIKE '%' + #{TEXT} + '%')
AND C.JOB_DUTY_NAME LIKE '%' + #{TEXT} + '%'
AND A.NAME LIKE '%' + #{TEXT} + '%'
ORDER BY CONVERT(INT, A.EMP_NO), A.JOIN_DATE, A.NAME
SELECT CONVERT(VARCHAR, MAX(CONVERT(INT, A.EMP_NO))) AS EMP_NO FROM dbo.TAD_TMP_EMP A WHERE A.OFFICE_CODE = #{LOGINUSER_OFFICE_CODE} AND A.EMP_GBN = #{EMP_GBN}
